name: Ford - Louisville Assembly Plant, Louisville KY

fieldNotes.facility: Louisville Assembly Plant (Ford Escape, Lincoln Corsair), 2000 Fern Valley Rd. Geocode landed on the rooftop (moved 15m); confirmed as the large assembly complex immediately south of Louisville International Airport / UPS Worldport, bounded by Fern Valley Rd to the north, Grade Lane to the west, and a rail corridor to the south. ~3.15M sq ft of building.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Secured Ford assembly campus with continuous perimeter chain-link fencing visible in multiple Street View captures along Grade Lane and Fern Valley Rd. Controlled truck access driveway off Fern Valley Rd into the west dock/yard area. A clearly visible internal vehicle-control gate (blue-roofed booth with gate arms and crosswalk markings) controls movement between the plant and finished-vehicle lots on the east side.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Ford assembly plants run staffed security gatehouses at controlled entrances; a distinct booth structure with gate arms is visible at the internal east checkpoint. Marked uncertain - the perimeter truck-gate booth could not be crisply isolated because Street View panos sit on the secured campus loop road rather than at the public-road gate itself.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Outer perimeter truck gate plus a separate internal vehicle-control checkpoint (booth + gate arms) between the plant and the finished-vehicle storage lots.
fieldNotes.railServed: Active rail yard with auto-rack rail cars running the full length of the south side of the plant; covered rail loading and adjacent trailer drop rows visible.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large dedicated trailer drop yard along the west side (Grade Lane frontage) plus trailer rows south of the building near the rail corridor - dozens of parked trailers without tractors.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ trailers visible across the west drop yard and south dock face.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted ~45 loading doors across the south and west building faces; banked dock doors with trailers backed in. Estimate from overhead imagery - marked uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on the south face and the west face, plus a separate finished-vehicle dispatch operation on the east - shipping and receiving run from physically separate clusters.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved aprons and multi-lane driveways at the Fern Valley Rd entry with unused width for an express bypass.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the dense Louisville metro fabric, hemmed by the international airport, interstate, and industrial corridor - Urban.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; left uncertain.
